candidates: testsuite/integration-arquillian/tests/base/src/test/java/org/keycloak/testsuite/organization/cache/OrganizationCacheTest.java:381 - Cleanup removes IDP with literal alias "alias" instead of the created IDP. The cleanup callback is registered as `identityProviders().get("alias")::remove`, but the IDPs created here are named `idp-alias-N`. At teardown the cleanup targets an IDP that doesn't exist, so it either fails or does nothing. The 20 IDPs, plus `idp-alias-20` created later, are left in the realm and can leak into other tests. Use the real alias, for example `final String alias = "idp-alias-" + i;` and `get(alias)::remove`. Apply the same fix to the `idp-alias-20` cleanup at line 425.
